website.readme_excerpt:
# GlamSwapCommandPlugin

Simple plugin for Dalamud that adds a command that allows users to swap their glamours to their currently selected gearset.


Usable in macros!
## Command:
/cgs [glamourNumber] 


Only numbers 1-20 are allowed.
